name: crow-pass-valley
caption: Crow Pass Valley, Alaska, July 15, 2017.
alt: A rocky alpine valley at Crow Pass with green mountain slopes, low clouds, and glacier ice at the right.
changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no crop or subject alteration.
rights_evidence: Wikimedia Commons records the National Park Service Alaska Region Flickr source and a CC BY 2.0 verification on September 26, 2021.
recommended_use: Crow Pass geographic explorer stop; the photographed valley is explicitly identified as Crow Pass by the source.

name: knik-townsite-cabin
caption: Cabin at the historic Knik townsite, Alaska, September 27, 2014.
alt: A low log cabin with a white door stands among birch trees at the historic Knik townsite.
changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no crop or subject alteration. These image derivatives are distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0.
rights_evidence: The photographer uploaded the image as their own work and explicitly granted CC BY-SA 3.0 on the source page.
recommended_use: Knik geographic explorer stop. This is Knik Site, not Knik River. The source locates the camera at 61.458056, -149.728056 and identifies National Register reference 73000379.

name: unalakleet-aerial
credit: Dr. John Cloud / NOAA Central Library
caption: Unalakleet village and river mouth, Alaska, August 2010.
alt: An aerial view of Unalakleet houses beside the river mouth, with winding waterways and green coastal flats beyond.
changes: Cropped the upper 650 pixels from the original 5184 by 3456 image to remove the airplane wing and excess sky, then resized and converted to WebP; no subject alteration.
rights_evidence: NOAA America’s Coastlines Collection image line5221, credited to Dr. John Cloud, NOAA Central Library; Commons identifies it as an official-duty US NOAA work in the public domain.
recommended_use: Unalakleet geographic explorer stop; photograph date is August 2010, not the 2012 Commons upload date.

name: iditarod-first-street-1910
credit: C. W. Felch / University of Washington Libraries, Special Collections, PH Coll 334.Flech7
caption: First Street in Iditarod, Alaska, July 20, 1910. Historical photograph.
alt: A black-and-white historical photograph of a broad dirt street, tents, and wooden buildings in Iditarod in July 1910.
changes: Converted to WebP and created a smaller version; no additional crop or subject alteration. The Commons source scan had previously been cropped along its border.
rights_evidence: The image bears its photographer, place, date, and a 1910 copyright statement; Commons marks the US-published photograph as public domain due to copyright expiration.
recommended_use: Iditarod historic-town explorer stop; always display the July 1910 date. Original is 768px wide and has not been upscaled.
